mechanism.claim: At the fixed UTC day boundary, unusually high completed-day BTC realized variation whose final twelve hours contain at least 65% of daily variance identifies a volatility impulse migrating toward the close. If the final six-hour return is nonzero and carries at least half of the absolute twelve-hour return, its direction should continue for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: sign of the completed final-six-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: DVBCR measures the temporal center of realized variance and late impulse dominance at one daily clock. HVDPR used three fixed eight-hour decisions, dual implied-volatility levels, same-sign four-hour returns, and path-efficiency ranks; JVCTR used hourly volatility cooling; RV20 used prior-calendar volatility with liquidation fields.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: daily realized variation must be in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily variance-center entry at 00:05 UTC is absent from Gross9

clock.decision: exact 00:00 UTC D after 24 consecutive source-valid completed BTC hours [D-24h,D)
clock.volatility_gate: strict-prior midrank against at most 180 valid days, minimum 126; rank>=0.65, current excluded
clock.variance_backloading: sum of squared final-12h returns / sum of squared 24h returns >=0.65
clock.late_direction: final-six-hour log return nonzero and abs(final6h return)>=0.50*abs(final12h return)
clock.reservation: fixed daily decisions; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.completed_hour: hash-bound historical cache joined to completed-hour PostgreSQL-derived tail through 2026-08-01
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent daily variance-center mechanism chosen before incidence

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, or subset repair.
